# DynamicNotchKit compatibility copy

Source: https://github.com/MrKai77/DynamicNotchKit
Version: 1.0.0
Commit: 3c405930fd4d9f8498303683f32492c26d3a9b2b
License: MIT (included in LICENSE)

This compatibility copy targets macOS 12. It replaces Duration-based sleeps
with nanosecond sleeps and provides older animation fallbacks. The optional
documentation plugin is omitted because this copy is used as a local build dependency.
